title: REALSORTER
description: This plugin helps to organnize chests after putting items in it they automatically gets organised and helps in server performace boost
body:
📦 RealSorter

RealSorter is a lightweight and efficient Minecraft plugin/mod that automatically organizes items in your chests, shulker boxes, and storage systems. No more messy inventories—keep everything sorted and easy to find!

✨ Features

🔄 Automatic Chest Sorting – Instantly sorts items by type, name, or category.

⚡ Fast & Optimized – Designed to handle large storage systems without lag.

🛠 Custom Sorting Rules – Define exactly how items should be arranged (by ID, rarity, category, etc.).

📂 Multi-Chest Support – Works across multiple connected chests or storage rooms.

🎮 Player-Friendly Commands – Simple commands or right-click actions for quick sorting.

🔌 Plugin/Server Compatibility – Works with Paper/Spigot and other major server types.

❓ Why Use RealSorter?

Minecraft storage gets messy fast, especially on SMPs. RealSorter makes managing items painless by automatically organizing everything. Whether you’re a builder, grinder, or just tired of clutter, RealSorter keeps your items neat and your gameplay smooth.
